CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The rig's colour. FIRST colour control in this list, so it is /controls/global/color/1 and /controls/scene/rigcolor - the same address every eclipse scene answers to. Defaults to red so the scene does something before a sender is driving it.
CONTROLS.NAME: rig_color

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The second colour the churn is painted with. SECOND colour control, so /controls/global/color/2 and /controls/scene/rigcolor2. Defaults to blue. Nothing sends this yet; eclipse-dmx sends one fixture.
CONTROLS.NAME: rig_color_2

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much of the two-colour paint job. 0 is stock Churning, its own rainbow untouched; 1 is only ever the two rig colours and what lies between them.
CONTROLS.NAME: rig_amount

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How hard the paint job pushes light against dark. Churning's texture lives mostly in hue, and a two-colour palette throws hue away - this puts some of that lost variation back as brightness so the strokes still read.
CONTROLS.NAME: rig_contrast
turbulence
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds more small swirling turbulence to the simulation when on.

CONTROLS.NAME: plasma
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Makes the simulation less like paint, more like overdriven plasma.

CONTROLS.NAME: broad_strokes
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: If you want smaller strokes, more consistent texture, less big swatches of colors, turn this off.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_phasing
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Causes the color palette to smoothly cycle in time.

CONTROLS.NAME: lift
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Lifts certain parts of the simulation on press, causing vertical streaks.

CONTROLS.NAME: swirl
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Swirls the entire simulation about the center on press.

CONTROLS.NAME: img_mix
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How heavily or subtly do you want the underlying Media or Video to be mixed in? Turn up to snap an image into focus, turn down to have it fade into colors.

CONTROLS.NAME: blur_on_fps
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON if you do not get any FPS lag and like the tilt-shift blur effect. Turn OFF to preserve FPS.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_push
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Keep ON to have the simulation automatically swirl and push based on the music. Turn OFF to manually control with manual push.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_push
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: auto push MUST BE SET TO OFF. Manually push the simulation forward and backward with this slider.

CONTROLS.NAME: dive_in
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 'Dive In' to the simulation. Best used by choosing a value and letting it sit, resulting in strange feedback fractals. Turn off your user image for a pure, clean look. Recommended to turn plasma ON.
